_README: Compact reference extracted from the donor files and the known-good 2010/2017 rosters. Use this instead of loading the 3.9MB donor. Appearance vocab is the validity check for tokens. Field ranges and per-position percentiles come from 2010/2017, which are known-good and played extensively - prefer these over donor values for anything content-related. growthType examples show the shape of a valid curve for each rating/potential gap; positive values must sum to gap*50 exactly.
appearance_vocab_note: #N/A removed - it came from a single corrupted donor record (surname "4", slots 0/5/6 broken). Never a valid token. Do not re-derive this vocabulary from the raw donor without filtering it out.
contract_length_note: Two constraints, both required. (1) LADDER: length must be consistent with draftSeason - recently drafted players are on rookie deals and the game blocks extensions if length says otherwise. (2) OVERALL SHAPE: the distribution is heavily weighted short - roughly 38% of rostered players are on 1-year deals and nothing exceeds 7. Fit both, not just the ladder.

team_ids.note: MODERN IDs for every season regardless of where the franchise played that year. 2004 San Diego = LAC, 2004 St. Louis = LAR, 2004 Oakland = LV. Period-correct IDs (SD/STL/OAK) break those teams on import. Verified identical across the 2004, 2010 and 2017 files.

VANILLA_authoritative._what: Exported from a FRESH PGM3 league generated by the game itself - no custom rosters, no games played. This is the only authoritative reference in the project. Where it disagrees with the donor or with our built files, IT WINS on questions of what the game does. For value RANGES prefer the union of built files, since this is a single league and a narrower sample.

confirmed_rules.schema: 52 roster keys, 72 staff keys - identical to ours
confirmed_rules.appearance_families: slots 0/5/6 share a digit, 2/3/4 share theirs - zero violations

CORRECTIONS_to_our_rules.50x_growthType: Applies to DRAFT PROSPECTS ONLY. Vanilla rookies obey 69%; rostered and free agents obey 0%. For veterans growthType is a full career arc whose positive portion has already been partly consumed. Our files enforce it on everyone (positive sum 0 for veterans) where vanilla veterans sit around 400. Inherited from the donor, which did the same. NOT YET corrected in the built files - they play fine and the mechanic is not understood. Build new files the vanilla way.
CORRECTIONS_to_our_rules.staff_startSeason: Has a REAL spread that tracks age: 1988-2024, 37 distinct values, correlation -0.972 with age. Formula: startSeason = -0.963*age + 2059.6, resid sd 2.26. Flat 2026 is wrong. 2010 and 2017 were flattened by mistake and have been restored.

ceilings._note: higher than the ceilings in our built files (27.6M/34.1M/40.9M) - the game allows more
